Their different multiplication orders permit materially inconsistent, finite outputs.

  Concrete falsifiers, all with `a=1` and only HI density nonzero:

  | `n_HI`, energy, comoving photons | Photon loss | Volume × species events |
  |---|---:|---:|
  | `1e-310`, `70 eV`, `1e300` | `0` | `1.73083e-19` |
